subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan for QuBit integration
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@qubit.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + Evaluation Plan for QuBit integration

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at QuBit is excited to evaluate Redwood for our assistant/agent use-case. Procurement asked me to get a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and evaluation plan on file so we can align timelines and decision gates.

High-level asks:
- Can you share a MAP template and a short evaluation-plan slide so our engineering + procurement teams can review?
- Target decision date: Aug 20, ideally with a short POC starting the week of Aug 10.
- Key criteria: latency under 200ms p50 on our 2k token tests, inference cost targets, and audit/logging evidence for SOC2 questions.

Would appreciate an initial draft by EOD tomorrow (Aug 4) that we can annotate. Happy to jump on a 30-min alignment call if needed.

Olivia Barnes
Head of Integrations | QuBit AI
olivia@qubit.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: none

Hi Olivia — great to hear. Attaching a starter MAP template and an evaluation-criteria slide deck; I also created two collaborative items so we can iterate in-place:

- Google Doc (MAP draft): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFG-hiJkLMNOPQqR/edit (edit access: olivia@qubit.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai)
- Google Slides (Eval criteria + timeline): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/2XyZ-MapSlides/edit

Attachments included: QU-BIT_MAP_template_v1.docx (lightweight editable copy), evaluation-criteria-slidev1.pptx (for quick offline review).

Proposal / immediate asks:
1) We will draft the MAP with milestone gates: SOW, security review, POC kickoff, POC signoff, procurement approval, and go/no-go by Aug 20.
2) I'll add a proposed POC schedule in the slides (POC window: Aug 10–Aug 17) and baseline success metrics.
3) Please upload any compliance artifacts we should reference (SOC2 reports, IP clauses).

Next steps: can your engineering lead confirm a 60-min sync on Wed (Aug 5) to walk through evaluation tests and data access? If not, we can do an internal review and send a revised draft for comments.

Thanks — putting Rishi and Laura on the thread to help finalize the MAP and SOW template.

—
Jasmine Liu

Jasmine — thanks for the quick turnaround and the links. I reviewed the doc and slides with procurement and engineering this morning. A few items from our side:

- Confirmed: we can start the POC the week of Aug 10 but need the POC acceptance criteria tightened (please add a section for error-rate during KB refresh and expected throughput under concurrent sessions).
- Timeline tweak: procurement prefers final approval on Aug 19 to allow for a 24-hr legal review buffer; can you adjust the MAP milestone to show procurement signoff by Aug 19?
- Compliance: I attached a short security questionnaire (QuBit_Security_QA.pdf) with specific SOC2 evidence requests — can your security team populate where applicable?

We made a few inline comments directly in the Google Doc. I gave edit access to our engineering lead (samuel@qubit.ai).

If you can circulate an updated MAP (doc + slides) by EOD Aug 5 with those changes, we'll lock the POC kickoff to Aug 10. Otherwise we'll need to delay by a week.

Thanks — Olivia
